summary: The positive-denominator characterization, crossing formula, containment, orientation, area scaling, and overflow equivalence are correct, as is the existence criterion on the zero-denominator branch. However, the candidate makes a false literal assertion about the status of the displayed formulas on that branch.
critical_errors: The statement that equations (3)-(7) are all undefined when beta+2-o=0 is false. On that branch o=2, so the polynomial inequality (7) is algebraically defined and reduces to 0>0, hence it is false, not undefined. Equation (4) also contains no quotient and becomes a well-defined true containment once the later permitted choice R=P is made. Only the quotient formulas (3), (5), and (6), together with any assertions using an as-yet-unselected unique R, are undefined.
repair_hints: Replace the blanket claim that (3)-(7) are undefined by the precise statement that (3), (5), and (6) have zero denominators; (4) is evaluated only after choosing a degenerate-branch R; and (7), although not obtained by an equivalence that permits division at this branch, is algebraically defined and specializes to the false inequality 0>0.
